rows.title: Design Quality Representative
rows.description:
Job Description


  • Evaluate all vehicle appearance item components for adherence to design intent of surface quality (including radii, parting line quality, sink marks, knit/flow lines, etc.), texture, gloss and color attributes for Appearance (AAR) sign-off to Master & PPAP submissions during all key program milestones.
  • Interface with program teams, design studio, engineering, and suppliers to understand design intent & provide feasibility relating to all appearance attributes & requirements (including surface development, parting line placement & quality, texture draft angle & metal removal specifications, material properties & capabilities, manufacturing process constraints).
  • During the development phase drive the TGSS (Tool grain specification sheets) process for all assigned programs to ensure design intent is met for all texture/grained parts (execution of specified grain, draft angle analysis & surface reviews, grain depth, tooling considerations, etc.) interfacing with internal and external key stakeholders (Design studio, Color & Materials, engineering, program teams, grain suppliers, Tier 1 suppliers).
  • Drive all Color Harmony Processes that directly affect Design Quality processes for all designated programs (including but not limited to TGSS, Mold Flow, Colour Harmony reviews, etc.).
  • Lead the Appearance Approval Process for Final Color Harmony from initial Studio Feasibility (Interior/Exterior) checkpoints, Color & Materials – Mastering, Raw Material, Tier 1 suppliers reviews, and product launch major milestones until OK to Buy has been achieved.
  • Interface with assembly plant, launch & supplier personnel to ensure design intent is met and maintained throughout the production of the parts & vehicles.
  • Lead & Support the Colour Harmony Process (CHP) for assigned programs.
  • Adapt timing plan for each model year and programs’ milestones.
  • Assist Colour Harmony team for key events (e.g., Supplier Awareness meeting, Launch Vehicle reviews, etc.)
  • Monitor program deliverables for progress to ‘on-time’ completion.
  • Develop & maintain Appearance Approval (AAR) tracking matrix.
  • Using PDL create appearance item list.
  • Update data for all changes (design intent, material, supplier, mfg. process, etc.).
  • Provide forecast & actual AAR sign-off timing.
  • Analyze data, provide metric reports & assist in issue resolution.
  • Highlight potential issues & escalate for resolution, especially any disconnects impacting ontime AAR & Colour Harmony sign-off.
  • Own, determine and provide Program team with OKtG and Final AAR tracking charts for presentation at Leadership & Directors reviews and lead report out where required.



Qualifications Required:


  • Above average color acuity (ability to distinguish subtle color / appearance differences)
  • Some CAD experience preferable (Vis-mockup, etc.)
  • Design Quality Experience (preferred)
  • Engineering degree a plus
  • Demonstrated ability to interface with multiple programs and functions.
  • Self-motivation and strong passion to engage team for quality improvements.
  • Demonstrated capability to teach/coach/mentor.
  • Demonstrated leadership and strong influencing skills by engaging cross function team for projects.
  • Strong experience in working in different cultures, systems, and processes.
  • Practical knowledge of Materials, Tooling, Manufacturing Processes, and Quality Standards & Methods
  • Practical knowledge of: GPDS, PPAP (Production Part Approval Process), DCAP (Decorative Component Approval Process), and Color Harmony Process
  • Key Deliverables in position (i.e., in the next 2-5 years what is required to be delivered in the position)

  • Prevent Recurrence - assist, prompt and where necessary drive LEA or Core to develop Prevent Recurrence Actions.
  • Best Practice - Develop & maintain a strong technical relationship with equivalent VFG leaders in FNA, FSAO and FoE. Ensure T6 cross plant and carline knowledge / efficiencies are utilized.
  • Reporting - Providing updates on V29 Quality metrics, for FQR or for Global teams (stack charts with breakpoints or 3MIS Status vs Target)
  • Reporting – Provide status updates on issues in key forums (EQR, CCRG, TDR…)
  • Proficient on using IS/IS not, Fault tree, Drill down analysis & 3L 5W are critical for problem solving
  • Buy-Back (RAV), QNPS - Awareness
  • New SAQ projects in define phase D0,1,2 (source WS, HTIS in IMG markets)
  • Top 10 Warranty Spend
  • Running Weekly QR & supporting PT Quality meetings in different time zones

  • Bachelor / Master Degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical Engineering
  • Min 10-12 years
  • Professional Exposure : Prior high level work as a Powertrain / Transmission related experience
  • Preferred previous experiences : Prior high level work as a Powertrain/Transmission Product Development Engineer + Issue management & Problem solving
  • Functional Skills : Knowledge on Powertrain as installed components, Engines, Transmission (Project management, Proficient on Problem solving tools - Analytical tools such as 8D, Fault tree, 3L 5W and is/is not. )
  • Behavioral Skills : Own working together: Build relationships with local and cross-functional teams, communicate clearly, drive team culture.
  • Deliver results: Strong influencing skills and leadership in a demanding environment, remote from the other regions
  • High energy, self-starter, with ability and desire to take responsibility and deliver results with minimal supervision.
  • Special Knowledge/Skills Required : Ability and courage to effectively communicate key issues and recommendations to senior management. Ability to work within a very diverse (culturally and functionally) environment. High integrity with good attitude and excellent communication skills. Ability to communicate with global team


Any Others : Position will require some flexibility in work schedule (Early morning and Late evenings)

Through a mix of design thinking methodologies, UX Research, design consultancy and strategies, we helped build over the last 15 years more than 400 world class web and mobile applications for some of the biggest global and local brands such as Master Card, Agoda, SCB, TTB, Kerry Express, BBC, JP Morgan, BCG, Prudential, HomePro, etc.

rows.title: Design Manager
rows.description:
Responsibilities

  • Assist in the development and training of the design team
  • Assist with budgets to actual variance explanations for projects
  • Support team to disrupt, improve, and evolve ways of working when necessary
  • Ensure all work areas meet quality and compliance standards
  • Establish creative strategy, budgets, and schedules for key design projects
  • Take responsibility for delivering designs on time
  • Operationalize and implement a standard system for design delivery
  • Work seamlessly across organizational structures, partnering with marketing, product, and business leadership to develop holistic brand systems
  • Manage development and review the quality and accuracy of large-scale project designs
  • Establish department goals and objectives that support the strategic plan
  • Partner with site and product teams to ensure the brand is consistent across the full customer journey
  • Capture all states, cases, and functional logic in partnership with the product and engineering team to ensure seamless execution
  • Partner with product leaders and build and maintain relationships to develop a clear understanding of overall business and technology strategy where design is a key part of what is delivered
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for design
  • Collaborate with a diverse group of stakeholders, including content developers, IT, senior management, internal business partners, and vendors
  • Keep a pulse on the culture of product design among designers and design partners to ensure designers are capable of doing their best work
  • Provide reporting on the implementation of projects while in progress and upon completion
  • Collaborate with product and marketing to educate on and maintain a cohesive brand
  • Solve business challenges with the goal of improving experience for prospects, customers, and staff
  • Maintain established corporate brand standards and consistency of messaging across all published materials and media


Requirements

  • 2-3 years minimum as a design manager or similar
  • A deep technical knowledge of the complete design process from brainstorming to end products
  • A creative drive and a keen eye for innovative ideas and trends
  • Effective supervisory and organizational skills
  • The ability to be a leader but to also know how to motivate team members
  • The patience and determination to resolve issues in a timely manner
  • Flexibility and dependability to work in multifaceted working environments
  • The ability to produce quality projects consistently
  •  Excellent communication skills – both written and oral
  • Experience with Figma and/or Sketch
  • Experience with UX design, UI design, and Agile software methodologies
  • Some knowledge of HTML and CSS is a big plus
  • A collaborator and problem solver
  • Prior experience as a consultant
  • A leader in project design and negotiation
  • Dedicated to organizational transformation
  • Strict attention to detail and prioritization capabilities
  • Good English and Thai communications
  • Preferably Thai citizen

rows.title: Senior UX/UI Designer
rows.description:
Responsibilities 

By partnering with cross-functional teams and customers, you will turn insights into delightful products in a creative environment that requires proven leadership skills and the ability to execute a creative vision.

  • Set design requirements based on information from internal teams and user research
  • Identify new product improvement opportunities
  • Analyze how a new product satisfies market needs and consumer preferences
  • Stay current on industry trends and market conditions
  • Coordinate with other design team members to ensure consistent and accurate communication
  • Modify and revise existing designs to meet changing customer preferences
  • Work closely with product engineers to suggest improvements for products and processes
  • Present product design ideas to cross-functional teams and senior leadership


Requirements

  • At least 3-5 years of experience as a product designer or UX/UI designer
  • Proven experience in all phases of the design process including user research, copywriting, wireframing, prototyping, visual design, interaction design, and usability testing
  • An intuitive eye for customer needs beyond the obvious
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Able to collaborate with cross-functional team members
  • Able to collect and interpret both qualitative and quantitative feedback
  • A well-rounded portfolio of client work, demonstrating a strong understanding of client objectives
  • Able to effectively communicate and persuade around design concepts
  • A passion for design, not satisfied with the status quo, and always thinking of ways to improve
  • Creative problem-solving skills
  • A dynamic, creative personality, effective at engaging and influencing a variety of audiences
  • Capable of providing assistance to product engineers when needed
  • Capable of recommending new tools and technologies by staying abreast of the latest trends and techniques

rows.title: Senior/Mid-Level Business Analyst
rows.description:
Key Responsibilities:

  1. Collaborate in the pre-sale process between business stakeholders and technical teams.
  2. Conduct detailed requirements gathering with stakeholders.
  3. Analyze and document business processes, workflows, and user requirements.
  4. Collaborate with solution architects and developers to design solutions.
  5. Validate solutions to ensure they meet business requirements.
  6. Create draft solution design pages (wireframes) to clarify and verify with stakeholders.
  7. Prepare and maintain proposal documents.
  8. Break down complex requirements into clear, actionable tasks to ensure manageability.
  9. Prepare user stories or backlog items descriptions for the development team and participate in sprint activities.
  10. Coordinate with project managers in planning and monitoring project activities.

 

Qualifications:

  1. Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  2. Mid-Level: 3-5 years of experience in business analysis or related field.
  3. Senior Level: 5-7 years of experience in business analysis or related field.
  4. Ability to work as part of a team.
  5. Excellent communication in speaking and writing skills in both English and Thai.
  6. Experience with SDLC and agile methodologies is desirable.
  7. Proficiency in business analysis tools and methodologies.
  8. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  9. Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.

 

Preferred Skills:

  1. Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., JIRA, Trello).
  2. Experience in leading and mentoring junior BAs is a plus.
  3. Experience in FinTech, AI, eCommerce, ERP, and Logistics is a plus.

rows.title: Business Development Manager & Account Manager
rows.description:
Requirements

  • English-speaking Thais and Expats are welcome. Business visa and work permit will be provided for qualified expat applicants.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Computer Science or other relevant area.
  • 5 years of proven success in B2B sales, preferably in the software development industry. Understanding of the SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) is essential.
  • Expertise and experience in Banking and the Financial Services industry is a big plus.
  • Experience in consultative selling and developing long-term client relationships.
  • Possess a well-established network of qualified prospects to be able to convert them into leads quickly.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts in a clear and compelling manner in English (and preferably Thai).
  • Strong negotiation skills, with the ability to create mutually beneficial agreements and navigate complex deal structures.
  • Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets and contributing to the overall growth of a business.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively while paying attention to details.
  • Strong sense of responsibility, commitment, ownership of tasks, and self-motivation.
  • Positive attitude, outgoing personality, and a good team player.


Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Understand in depth the company’s service offerings, employees, customers, technologies used, portfolio, selling points, customer pain points, and target audience.
  • Actively seek out new business opportunities, whether through cold calls, referrals, networking or other means.
  • Prospecting and lead generation.
  • Account management.
  • Receive and qualify inbound leads generated by marketing efforts, ensuring a thorough understanding of their needs and requirements.
  • Work diligently to convert qualified leads into opportunities, understanding client pain points and proposing tailored solutions.
  • Develop and present detailed project proposals to clients, outlining the scope, timeline, and deliverables based on collaboration with the Business Analysis team to gather comprehensive requirements for the scope of work and with the software development team to obtain a technical solution and accurate estimates for the work involved.
  • Drive the negotiation process, address client concerns, and work towards successfully closing deals, ensuring the best possible outcomes for both the client and the company.
  • Foster strong relationships with clients through highly responsive and effective communication and engagement, showcasing the value propositions of our software development services.
  • Stay informed about industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor activities, providing valuable insights to refine our sales strategies.
  • Collaborate closely with the marketing team to provide feedback on lead quality, market trends, and areas for improvement in lead generation.
  • Utilize CRM tools to maintain accurate and up-to-date records of sales activities, track progress, and generate regular reports for management review.
  • Represent the company at trade shows and tech conferences.

rows.title: Business Process Outsourcing - Technical Accounting Director
rows.description:
Duties and Responsibilities

Technical Skills:

  • In-depth knowledge of Thai accounting principles, processes and standards to ensure compliance with local regulations.
  • In-depth knowledge of Thai GAAP and IFRS standards including experience in conversion from other countries.
  • Proficiency in Thai tax laws and regulations, including knowledge of corporate income tax, VAT, withholding tax, and other relevant taxes.
  • Experience in preparing, analyzing and converting financial statements in accordance with Thai Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (Thai GAAP).
  • Experience in preparing, analyzing and converting financial statements in accordance with Thai International Finance Reporting Standards (Thai IFRS).
  • (Useful) IFRS 17 conversion experience
  • Proficient in financial modeling and analysis, with a focus on providing insights into the financial performance and health of the organization.
  • Knowledge of risk assessment and management techniques, with a focus on identifying and mitigating financial risks specific to the Thai business environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in detailed annotation of finance processes, for example Work Instructions.
  • Understanding of relevant Thai business laws, contracts, and regulatory frameworks affecting financial transactions.
  • Stay current with changes in accounting standards, regulations, and industry best practices.
  • Provide technical guidance to clients and internal teams on complex accounting issues and transactions.

Technology Skills:

  • Willingness and ability to leverage technology, including financial software and tools, for automation, data analysis, and streamlined financial processes.
  • (Preferable) Familiarity with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems commonly used in Thailand for efficient financial management and reporting.
  • Highly proficient in the use of advanced Excel.

Service Development and Expansion:

  • Implement the strategic vision for the technical accounting services offered by Grant Thornton in Thailand and actively contribute to its ongoing evolution.
  • Continually identify market trends, client needs, and potential opportunities to expand and enhance technical accounting offerings.
  • Become a recognized and sought after leader in Thailand in this field through marketing, presentations, and events.
  • (Preferable) Have participated in the set up or transition of a Shared Service Centre

Client Relationship Management:

  • Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with existing clients and demonstrate a sound understanding of their specific technical accounting needs.
  • Collaborate with teams across Grant Thornton Thailand and abroad to identify and pursue new business opportunities.

Team Leadership:

  • Build and lead a high-performing technical accounting team, providing guidance and fostering a culture of excellence and innovation, especially towards digital technologies.
  • Develop and implement training programs to enhance the team's technical skills and knowledge.

Quality Assurance:

  • Understanding and continual learning of financial regulations and compliance requirements set by the Thai Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and other relevant authorities.
  • Implement rigorous quality assurance processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of technical accounting services delivered by the team.
  • Conduct regular reviews and audits to maintain high standards of service delivery.

Collaboration and Cross-Functional Integration:

  • Build a strong collaborative relationship with all services in Grant Thornton to be able to provide joint solutions where technical accounting can participate.



﻿Qualification

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • CPA or equivalent certification preferred.
  • Extensive experience (10+ years) in technical accounting roles, with a strong understanding of IFRS, local GAAP, and relevant regulations in Thailand.
  • Proven track record of successfully developing and managing technical accounting services.
  • Evidence experiences in finance transformation using contemporary digital tools.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • An advantage to have experience in Shared Service Centre roles or transitions.

rows.description:
As a Director - Internal Auditor within our BRS team, you will:

  • Lead and manage complex internal audit projects, overseeing the planning, execution, and reporting phases to ensure alignment with company objectives and industry standards.
  • Conduct risk assessments to identify and evaluate business and operational risks, developing audit plans and strategies to mitigate identified risks effectively.
  • Provide strategic insights based on audit findings, offering recommendations for improvements in processes, controls, and governance practices.
  • Foster relationships with key stakeholders, including senior management and department heads, to facilitate open communication and collaboration on audit-related matters.
  • Guide and mentor a team of audit professionals, promoting a culture of continuous learning and professional development within the Internal Audit department.
  • Stay abreast of emerging trends, regulatory changes, and best practices in internal auditing and corporate governance, incorporating these insights into the audit strategy.


Desired Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, with a Master's degree or professional certifications (such as CIA, CPA, or CISA) highly preferred.
  • A minimum of 8-10 years of progressive experience in internal auditing, with prior leadership roles in a corporate or consulting environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in risk assessment, audit methodology, and regulatory compliance.
  • Strong analytical skills and a detail-oriented approach, capable of conducting thorough investigations and analyses.
  • Exceptional leadership and team management abilities, with a track record of developing high-performing audit teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex issues clearly and concisely to diverse audiences.
  • Proficiency in audit software and applications, as well as Microsoft Office Suite.

  • Cultivate new and existing relationships to expand our service offerings and generate new business opportunities.
  • Manage project timelines meticulously, ensuring all client expectations and critical issues are communicated effectively to prevent surprises.
  • Uphold the highest standards of professionalism, representing Grant Thornton with integrity and excellence in all interactions.
  • Lead and develop the Transaction Advisory Services Team, fostering a learning, growth, and collaboration culture.

  • Proven leadership skills with a track record of managing teams and leading successful projects.
  • Strong negotiation and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence internally and externally.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modelling capabilities.

  • Perform any other duties as assigned by supervisors.


Transfer Pricing

  • Assist in preparing Transfer Pricing documentation to comply with Thai transfer pricing requirements.
  • Conduct benchmarking studies and support advisory and related works.
  • Help in addressing client needs and interact with clients under the guidance of senior team members.
  • Collaborate with international colleagues on various Transfer Pricing projects.
  • Ensure assignments are completed with high quality, efficiency, and punctuality.
  • Participate in business development initiatives and support work related to interactions with the Revenue Department.

  • Perform any other duties as assigned by supervisors.

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Good command of both spoken and written English.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to work effectively in a team.
  • Eagerness to learn and develop knowledge in transfer pricing and other tax-related areas.
  • Familiarity with other tax areas is an advantage.

-ม.6, ปวช. ,ปวส. หรือ ปริญญาตรี

rows.title: Wholesales & OMT & Special Channel Assistant Section Head
rows.description:
Job Responsibility

- จัดทำแผนการดำเนินการขายและเป้าหมายประจำปี (Annual Sales Operation Plan) และแนวทางการปฏิบัติงาน รวมทั้งแผนงบประมาณประจำปีการบริหารร้านค้า ของแผนก Wholesales & OMT

- ร่วมประชุมกับฝ่ายการขาย การตลาด หัวหน้าภาค เพื่อสรุปยอดเป้าการขาย, งบประมาณพร้อมทั้งรับเป้าการขายรายปี

- ถ่ายทอดนโยบายการขาย การตลาด สำหรับสินค้าที่รับผิดชอบ เพื่อจัดทำแนวทางการดำเนินงานในแต่ละพื้นที่

- ให้แนวทางในการกำหนดการปฏิบัติการขายในเรื่องต่างๆ เพื่อสนับสนุนการดำเนินงานให้เป็นไปอย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ เช่น ป้ายโฆษณา, น้ำแถม, การตั้งวงเงินยืมร้านค้า, การตรวจสอบอายุลูกหนี้ เป็นต้น

- กำหนดแนวทางเพื่อสร้างความสัมพันธ์ที่ดีกับลูกค้า/คู่ค้าในระยะยาว โดยวิเคราะห์ร้านค้าที่ขายดี หรือ ร้านค้าที่หยุดการซื้อ และกำหนดการเข้าเยี่ยม และตรวจเยี่ยมคู่ค้า

- กำหนดแนวทางและบริหารจัดการกิจกรรมส่งเสริมการขายหรือ Promotion ของส่วนงานWholesales & OMT


Job Qualification

- ปริญญาตรี หรือโท ทุกสาขา

- ประสบการณ์ด้านWholesales & OMT ตั้งแต่ 5-7 ปี ขึ้นไป

- เข้าใจระบบการขายในรูปแบบค้าส่ง และมีประสบการณ์การบริหารทีมงาน

rows.title: หัวหน้าเขตทีมขาย
rows.description:
Job Responsibility

- ร่วมจัดทำแผนการดำเนินการขายและเป้าหมายประจำปี และงบประมาณประจำปีให้สอดคล้องกับกลยุทธ์ธุรกิจ

- จัดทำแผนการปฏิบัติการขายในเรื่องต่างๆ ของพื้นที่ที่รับผิดชอบ เพื่อสนับสนุนการดำเนินงานให้เป็นไปอย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ เช่น ป้ายโฆษณา, น้ำแถม, การตั้งวงเงินยืม

- ติดตาม ตรวจสอบ และร่วมแก้ปัญหา เพื่อให้แผนงานดำเนินไปได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ

- กำหนดแนวทางเพื่อสร้างความสัมพันธ์ที่ดีกับลูกค้า/คู่ค้าในระยะยาว


Job Qualification

- ปวส. หรือ ปริญญาตรี ขึ้นไป ทุกสาขา

- ประสบการณ์ด้านการขาย (Van Sales) 3-5 ปีขึ้นไป หากมีประสบการณ์บริหารทีมงานจะพิจารณาเป็นพิเศษ

- มีใบขับขี่รถยนต์ส่วนบุคคล หากมีใบขับขี่ บ.2-ท.2 จะพิจารณาเป็นพิเศษ

- มีความรับผิดชอบสูง สามารถยืดหยุ่นเวลาทำงานได้

- มีมนุษย์สัมพันธ์ที่ดี มีทักษะการสื่อสาร วิเคราะห์ข้อมูล และประสานงานกับหน่วยงานที่เกี่ยวข้องได้ดี

company.name: Iron Software
company.introduction:
Iron Software produces software libraries for C# / .NET engineers working with PDFs, OCR, Excel, QR & barcodes, and data scraping.


Trusted by single developers, start-ups, and engineers at NASA, Tesla, the US State Department, and more. With over 20 million downloads on NuGet in 95+ countries, Iron Software is an international company with its headquarters in Chicago, USA and an Asia base in Chiang Mai, Thailand.

rows.title: Senior Software Engineer
rows.description:
Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to automate software deployment processes.
  • Collaborate with development teams to optimize code deployment, configuration management, and release engineering processes.
  • Implement monitoring and alerting solutions to ensure system stability, performance, and availability.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to infrastructure, deployment, and software quality.
  • Implement security best practices throughout the development and deployment lifecycle.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices in DevOps, cloud computing, and automation technologies.
  • Document processes, procedures, and configurations to ensure reproducibility and scalability.
  • Deliver on and set deadlines under our monthly product release cycle.


Skills & Qualifications:

  • 2 - 6 years of experience as a Software Engineer/Developer or similar role.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Strong understanding of software development principles and technologies.
  • Can develop complex and robust software in C#, C++, Java or similar language.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple tasks.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools.
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of AWS and Azure cloud computing platforms.
  • Fluent knowledge of version control systems such as Git.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies.


Preferred Experience:

  • Strong knowledge or certification in DevOps or cloud technologies (e.g, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert)
  • Very strong understanding of operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux distros) and deployment targets (Docker, AWS, Kubernetes, Google Cloud).
  • Experience developing and deploying NuGet packages
  • Experience with configuring mobile support especially with complex runtime libraries involved
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation using languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell.

rows.description:
Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain SOPs for sales and marketing operations, ensuring they are streamlined, up-to-date, and efficiently support activities.
  • Administrate our CRM system (HubSpot), optimizing sales processes, tracking interactions, forecasting sales, and reporting on team performance.
  • Support data integrity initiatives by performing data editing and cleansing exercises, ensuring accurate and clean data is maintained within our systems.
  • Assist in customer service, managing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Identify and qualify potential leads, providing senior sales and partnership personnel with the information needed for targeted sales efforts.
  • Work closely with both the sales and marketing teams, with a primary focus on sales, to align sales operations with broader business objectives.
  • Prepare reports and analyses for the CRM and Marketing Operations Manager, providing insights that contribute to strategic decision-making.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends and CRM technology advancements to recommend improvements to our sales processes.
  • Having basic knowledge about automations and willing to learn


Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or related field.
  • 1-3 years of experience in data, CRM, sales operations, customer service, or a related role, preferably within the technology or software industry.
  • Proficiency in HubSpot or similar CRM software.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to create clear and effective SOPs.
  • Detail-oriented and strong problem-solving skills
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks and adapt in a dynamic environment.
  • Excellent analytical skills, capable of identifying trends and insights from data.
  • Proven commitment to high-quality customer service.
  • Team-oriented, with a proactive and problem-solving approach.

  • Assist with the execution of finance & legal tasks related to Business Services activities, such as expense reports, contract review, and regulatory compliance
  • Provide efficient administrative support, including scheduling meetings, managing calendars, call support, and handling travel arrangements
  • Identify and implement opportunities with manager to improve Business Services operational efficiency through process optimization and automation
  • Provides administrative support to ensure efficient office operations.
  • Completes operational requirements by scheduling and assigning administrative projects and expediting work results.
  • Writing And Issuing Emails/slack team members and departments on behalf of the company or senior staff
  • Finding a way to improve administrative processes.
  • Assisting all the Business Services department activities.
  • Identify and fill important gaps across the business.
  • Learning skills and roles needed for our business activities
  • Be able to create report/documentation for senior management
  • Financial records (Weekly / monthly)
  • Maintain or improve Financial/accounting to better processes
  • Be able to create financial reports
  • Be able to contact/negotiate with external and government officers such as Immigration/ The Revenue Department/ District or Company Lawyer.

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • Educated to Degree level or equivalent. Graduating in Business Management/ Administration or Accounting field would be an advantage.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks effectively
  • Some knowledge of various project management methodologies (e.g., agile/scrum)
  • Proficient in; PM software tools such as Slack, Trello, Excel, and Word.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills
  • Problem-solving skills
  • Capacity to manage high-stress situations
  • Ability to multi-task and manage various project elements simultaneously
  • Proven leadership skills
  • Big-picture thinking and vision
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in work.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Positive attitude and team player
  • Fluent in English ( Business level: Written/ Speaking and Listening)

rows.title: Research Manager
rows.description:
KEY OUTCOMES

  • You will contribute to the BU's business success by managing a high performing team to deliver great work and seeking out further opportunities.
  • Manage and develop strong client relationships and have a good understanding of clients’ business and market, utilizing your research expertise and proprietary Kantar Insights solutions.
  • You will be involved in client engagement, consultancy, study design and analysis, driving preparation and delivery of presentations and reports as well as broader business responsibilities including seeking new business, people management and the implementation of broader business initiatives to improve business performance.
  • Direct the team’s efforts in the most effective use of analytic processes and research methodologies to address clients’ business issues.
  • Provide constant delivery of strong consumer insights to clients and ensure client deliverables meet expectations and needs.
  • Conducts research in compliance with the ISO 20252 standard, as represented in the Company’s Quality Manual and supporting procedures


CAPABILITIES

  • Bachelor’s degree, ideally in Marketing At least 5 years progressive experience managing high volume quantitative research studies, interfacing with clients to proactively deliver on agreed KPIs; including people management experience
  • Strong capability to lead and a team and mentoring
  • Proven Experience in Market research or Consumer Insights within agencies or end-users
  • Experience with brand health tracking, ad testing, U&As and other market research techniques; keen ability to recognize and articulate the story
  • Build new clients and nurture existing relationships with clients and internal stakeholders
  • Strong communications and presentation skills
  • Experienced in developing team members through coaching and performance management.
  • Able to manage projects and the team to contribute towards achievement of financial targets, through developing client relationships, managing key supplier relationships, as well as instilling a learning culture among the team.
